name: Pad Follower
description: Grows a soft string-section pad out of whatever you play: the same chord swells in behind you, follows your harmony as it changes and fades when you stop.

params.name: Rise
params.description: How slowly the pad swells in after you play. Short doubles each note almost at once; long lets the pad arrive well after the chord.

params.name: Fall
params.description: How long the pad hangs on after the sound stops. Long settings leave the last chord standing while you play the next.

params.name: Sensitivity
params.description: How quiet a sound may be and still become pad. Low settings follow only what is played firmly; high settings pick up soft notes, and with them more noise and ringing.

params.name: Octaves
params.description: Adds a second section to the pad: the octave below towards the left, the octave above towards the right. In the middle the pad plays only the pitches you played.

params.name: Brightness
params.description: Low-pass on the pad. Lower settings push it further behind the instrument; higher ones let its upper partials and the octave above shine.

params.name: Ensemble
params.description: How many players the pad seems to have. At zero it is one steady voice per note; raising it adds the slow detuned chorus of a string section.

params.name: Movement
params.description: Slow drift in level and position across the registers of the pad, so a held chord keeps shimmering instead of standing still.

params.name: Low Cut
params.description: Takes the lows out of the pad so it does not cloud the bass of the instrument. The dry signal is not affected.

params.name: Width
params.description: Stereo spread of the pad. Zero puts the whole pad in the centre; full spreads the section across the speakers. The dry signal keeps its own image.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the instrument and the pad. Zero is the instrument alone, full is the pad alone.
